title: Slovakian Burger
description: A traditional Slovakian-inspired burger made with a beef patty, topped with cheese and served on a toasted bun.
instructions: Form the burger patty and season with salt and pepper.
Place the burger patty on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the bread by placing it in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Assemble the burger by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by the cooked burger patty, cheese, and finally the top bun.
